metadata.title: FFT AI Edition – Overview (v1.3 Draft)
metadata.subtitle: Conceptual Map of Architecture • Layers • Runtime • Session
metadata.description: Defines the non-authoritative overview projection for FFT AI Edition v1.3.

status_line: Overview is a projection only; authoritative values come from manifest, registry, and module specifications.

core.description: Foundational kernel of FFT AI Edition.

substrate_runtime.description: Execution substrate, compatibility, lattice, and runtime.

session_layer.description: Full session model including state, context, alignments, log, dashboard, overlay, history, UI, profile, analytics, awareness.

operators_structures.description: Operators, regimes, invariants, structures, validation, examples.

ai_runtime_layer.description: Autonomy, discovery, execution graph, navigation, capabilities, integrations, registry, RTT spine, prompts.

relationships.session_to_runtime: Session files define state; runtime enforces execution and collapse.
relationships.operators_to_rtt: Operators map directly to RTT nodes and regime transitions.
relationships.analytics_to_measures: Analytics derive from measure IDs; no invention allowed.
relationships.awareness_to_profile: Awareness defines cognitive envelope; profile defines identity envelope.
relationships.execution_graph_to_navigation: Execution graph defines flow; navigation defines movement.

rtt: RTT nodes MUST map to frozen RTT v0.9 quantities.
regime: Regime MUST match RTT node according to fft.ai.regimes.json.

non_claims: Overview does not revise RTT v0.9.
Overview does not reinterpret SET, S–N–R, or triadic time.
Overview does not replace the human FFT book.
